title: The pushforward along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism has a right adjoint
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file duality.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y between quasi-separated and quasi-compact schemes, the lemma asserts that the functor Rf_* : D_QCoh(O_X) -> D_QCoh(O_Y) has a right adjoint (statement lines 652-678; the statement carries a reference block recording that the result is almost the same as Example 4.2 of the cited paper by Neeman). The proof verifies the hypotheses of the adjoint functor theorem, Derived Categories, Proposition labelled derived-proposition-brown: the category D_QCoh(O_X) has direct sums by Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-direct-sums and is compactly generated by Derived Categories of Schemes, Theorem labelled perfect-theorem-bondal-van-den-Bergh, and since X and Y are quasi-compact and quasi-separated the morphism f is too, so Rf_* commutes with direct sums by Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-pushforward-direct-sums (proof lines 680-694). Invoking the brown representability criterion after checking generation and preservation of direct sums is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
